finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the number of bytes received exceeds 1024, it will overflow the buffer.
finding.assumptions: The buffer size is fixed at 1024 bytes, and the recv function does not perform bounds checking.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the code for any checks on the size of the data received before it is stored in the buffer. Found a check on line 4 that ensures bytesReceived is greater than 0 before processing the data. This implies that the code is designed to handle cases where the number of bytes received is less than or equal to the buffer size.
